name: contract-static-before-visual
goal: Keep generated app static audit failures visible before mandatory screenshot baseline admission

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Mandatory screenshot comparison now stops a fresh generated app check at missing baselines before audit. The existing ecosystem app case expects svelte-script-lang and fails at d26e0fdbea; direct audit still reports it.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The app generator case checked only that audit appeared in the script, not its position. Strengthen that same case with static-gate ordering and retain all rules in the existing disposable app violation case. Counts and titles stay fixed.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test-only 9be2073cee, laptop record d5c6e9480573 fails the actual svelte-script-lang audit assertion and generated policy controls; three failures, four passes. Recorded before product repair.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move static audit ahead of visual admission. Guard every new mandatory gate through the existing generator-order and real CLI static-violation cases; retain cases, checks and missing-baseline refusal.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Product-only bebb9c6d2b moves generated app audit before test/e2e, keeps every gate, and updates generated and repository agent guidance. Frozen tests and case counts remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched laptop green dd6161784252 passes all seven unchanged cases after red d5c6e9480573. Static violations precede browser setup; same command, inputs, expectations, environment and resource lease.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
